description: Auto-fire gh-CLI workflow governor. Fires when an sdd skill or the operator runs a GitHub issue or pull-request operation — open an issue, start work on one, open a PR, merge a PR, or close one unmerged. Shapes the gh workflow: generic issue/PR structures, per-PR issue-linked branch, squash-merge with branch cleanup, `Closes #<issue>` linkage. Not for plain git ops (commit, push) nor `gh release` — the release skill owns version tag + release notes.
